description: The HiTiSEA research team publishes Python scripts for calculating indoor and outdoor human thermal-stress indices. The own code page identifies indoor UTCI, shaded and unshaded outdoor UTCI, mean radiant temperature and eight other empirical indices. A small TAR.GZ source package is freely available from Figshare under CC0. The associated demonstration processes ERA5 and ERA5-Land for South and East Asia over 1981–2019, while reuse can follow another compatible meteorological domain and time step. These calculations can prepare exposure indicators for climate-adaptation simulations or environmental inputs considered alongside model-energyplus and data-era5-reanalysis. A caveat is that the short code landing page does not list every function signature or numerical limit. Indoor and shade assumptions need checking before representing specific buildings or urban spaces. The archive was identified through metadata but was not downloaded, installed or executed.
